title: color-group — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one behavioral case for protocol::color_group::parse_color_groups_array — the canonical-JSON decoder for the color_groups array embedded in vault.prefs (MYND-604, graph color groups; protocol.md §9.5.2). The decoder accepts a JSON array of ColorGroup objects (id, name, color, enabled, filter AST), tolerating insignificant whitespace and unknown future keys (forward-compat) while enforcing a closed allow-list (the reused saved_view FilterNode kinds and PropertyOp operators are closed sets; no JSON floats). It returns the decoded rules plus the number of bytes consumed — the cursor-advance contract the embedding prefs codec relies on. Structural twin of saved-view, with one defining divergence: the array is re-encoded in CALLER ORDER verbatim, NEVER id-sorted, because array position IS rule precedence (first match wins) — the exact invariant a port could break by copying the saved_views id-sort. Not an on-disk codec and not cryptographic by itself (the bytes are decoded only after the vault.prefs AEAD verified) — it is deterministic cross-client behavior: every independent client decodes the same bytes to the same rule-set and consumed length. Two case kinds: 'parse_ok' (decoded set pinned as its canonical re-encoding via canonical_encode_color_groups — verbatim precedence order + NFC folding + lexicographic per-object key order color<enabled<filter<id<name — plus the consumed byte count) and 'parse_fail' (the closed error surface). Rust reference: protocol/src/color_group.rs (main myne repository).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'color-group/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped — downstream test runners may reference these strings.

oneOf.title: parse_ok — pin the decoded rule-set (as its canonical re-encoding) and the consumed byte count

input_bytes_utf8_hex.description: The input bytes as exact UTF-8 (hex). A canonical JSON array, optionally followed by trailing bytes the embedding codec continues past (the trailing-data case pins that consumed < input length).

expected_consumed_len.description: The exact number of input bytes the decoder MUST report as consumed (the array length, never including trailing bytes). Embedding codecs advance their cursor by this count.

expected_canonical_utf8_hex.description: The canonical re-encoding (canonical_encode_color_groups) of the decoded rule-set as exact UTF-8 bytes (hex). Captures VERBATIM precedence order (never id-sorted), NFC folding, lexicographic per-object key order, and unknown-field drop — the normalization a conformant decoder MUST converge to.

oneOf.title: parse_fail — pin the closed error surface

input_bytes_utf8_hex.description: The malformed/invalid input bytes as exact UTF-8 (hex).

expected_error.description: The ColorGroupParseError variant the decoder MUST return: malformed (not well-formed canonical JSON / forbidden float / over-deep nesting), missing_field (a required field absent — id/name/color/enabled/filter), wrong_type (a field present with the wrong JSON type), unrepresentable (a value outside the closed allow-list — unknown filter kind, unknown comparison operator).
